intro.fr: Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Zoltun456/Archipelago-BG3-ToT, qui héberge l'APWorld de Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav.
text.en: The GitHub repository Zoltun456/Archipelago-BG3-ToT, home of the Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.2.2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (16 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.2.2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (16 versions released).

text.fr: Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Baldur's Gate 3 - Trials of Tav is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
